exposure: introduction of milk or formula before 6 months
residence in southern cities of Brazil
outcome: breastfeeding duration up to 1 year postpartum
cohort: The cohort consisted of 2,220 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) recruited from prenatal clinics within the Brazilian National Health System.
finding: The probability of breastfeeding at 1 year postpartum was 53.5%, and factors associated with an increased risk of weaning included introducing milk or formula before 6 months, reporting breastfeeding problems, being Caucasian, smoking during pregnancy, and living in specific southern Brazilian cities.
